rachael: Heads-up 5: Partner Northway submitted a ticket — INV-NW-2026-10-12 shows a negative balance because PROMO-STARTUP was applied to both partner and end-customer line, net overcredit $7,350. They're asking for a refund but our policy prefers debit memo reversal when partner authorizes.
billing-bot: Alert: rule promo_overlap_v4 flagged INV-NW-2026-10-12  identical promo id PROMO-STARTUP applied to two linked line_items.
ben: can you paste the invoice rows? need promo ids and amounts to confirm net.
rachael: CSV snippet attached:```
INV-NW-2026-10-12 | Northway | LineItem: HOSTED-INFER | 14,700.00 | qty 1
INV-NW-2026-10-12 | Northway | Promo: PROMO-STARTUP | -7,350.00 | promo_id:PROMO-STARTUP
INV-NW-2026-10-12 | Northway | Promo: PROMO-STARTUP | -7,350.00 | promo_id:PROMO-STARTUP  <-- applied to partner and customer
Invoice balance: 0.00 (should be 7,350.00 due)
```
owen: thanks. two decision points: (A) treat as promo reversal (contra-revenue) or (B) issue goodwill refund (expense) if partner refuses reversal. GL difference matters.
mia-finance: finance prefers promo reversal as contra-revenue to keep revenue integrity. Proposed journal: DEBIT 4-2175 Promotional Contra $7,350 / CREDIT 1-1100 Accounts Receivable $7,350. Tag NW-210.
rachael: partner ops note: "Northway confirms the duplicate application resulted from our billing sync error. We authorize a debit memo instead of refund." I'll attach their signed confirmation.
ben: ok with that. who signs the memo? policy: partner sign + Partnerships lead for <10k. CFO only >25k.
partners: Partnership ops will countersign. We'll also ask them if they want a partner-facing note for their customers.
billing-bot: Action created: reversal_case RC-NW-2026-330 amount 7350 status pending_memo_sign. Notification suppression: true.
owen: timeline for posting after memo signed? Accounting: post reversal in the period of original invoice to avoid recognition mismatch. Use invoice date 2026-10-12.
mia-finance: confirm. Also attach original invoice PDF and partner ack to NetSuite journal entry for audit trail. We'll tag transaction with contract NW-CON-45.
rachael: I'll draft debit memo text: "Debit Memo DM-NW-2026-10A: reversal of duplicate PROMO-STARTUP on INV-NW-2026-10-12. Amount: $7,350. Partner approved." Routing to Partnerships + Legal now.
ben: once signed, post journal: DEBIT 4-2175 / CREDIT 1-1100, memo ref RC-NW-2026-330.
billing-bot: Note: created ticket B-REF-993 to patch billing rule that allowed promo to cascade to linked lines. Engineering pinged.
rachael: thanks all 5: I'll upload signed memo and mark complete after posting.
partners: please coordinate any external comms after posting.
rachael: closing on my side once journal is posted :white_check_mark:
